cards.text: Zechariah, a prophet (Zechariah 1:1), is in the middle of a night full of visions from the LORD (Zechariah 1:8). The angel who's been speaking with him comes back and wakes him, as a man is awakened from his sleep. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, and nobody ever came to wake ME up.

cards.question: The angel asks, “What do you see?” Zechariah describes a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top and ___ lamps on it, each with a spout.
Beside the gold lampstand, one on the right of the bowl and one on the left, Zechariah sees two trees. What kind are they?

cards.text: Zechariah asks the angel, “What are these, my lord?” and the angel fires right back, “Do you not know what they are?” Friend, that's the boss at work saying “You don't KNOW?” and suddenly your whole face is hot.

cards.question: When the angel asks if he knows what these things are, Zechariah says yes, he knows.

cards.text: Zechariah just says no, and I RESPECT that, because I lay on top of instruction manuals in that drawer for years and never once admitted I couldn't read one. So the angel tells him this is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah (Haggai 1:1).

cards.question: In the LORD's word to Zerubbabel, it's not by might and not by power. Then by what?

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks right to a mountain: “What are you, O great mountain?” Friend, that's me every night, squaring up to a stack of dirty cookie sheets taller than my hat.

cards.question: The LORD's word says that before Zerubbabel, the great mountain will become a ___.

cards.text: Once that mountain is flat, out comes the finishing touch: the capstone. That's the last chocolate chip pressed on top of the batch, the moment the whole kitchen knows it's DONE.

cards.question: The capstone comes out with shouts of “Grace, grace to it!” Who does the LORD's word say will bring it forth?

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes to Zechariah. The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, the house of God in Jerusalem (Ezra 5:2).

cards.question: The LORD's word says Zerubbabel's hands laid the foundation of the house, but someone else's hands will complete it.

cards.text: Then the word asks, “For who has despised the day of small things?” Friend, my very first stamp looked like somebody SAT on the dough, and I'm STILL proud of it.

cards.question: The seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the ___ in the hand of Zerubbabel.

cards.text: Zechariah's got more questions, and he asks the angel, “What are the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand?” That's me at a bakery counter going “Just ONE more question,” and then asking four.

cards.question: Zechariah presses further and asks about two olive branches beside two gold pipes. Golden oil pours from those pipes.

cards.text: The angel asks, “Do you not know what these are?” and for the second time Zechariah answers, “No, my lord.” I love it, friend, the man is CONSISTENT.

cards.question: At last the angel answers Zechariah's question about the olive trees and branches. What does he say they are?

answers.text: Two anointed ones standing beside the Lord
Two watchmen standing on the city wall
Two guards standing at the temple gate

cards.text: And that's where this vision ends for now. But keep that apron on, friend, because Zechariah's night isn't over yet.
